catalog.title: Recently added games
catalog.subtitle: The catalogue Ludex knows so far.
catalog.empty: No games yet. The catalogue fills up as games get added.

backlog.title: My backlog
backlog.emptyHint: Add your first game: search the title, pick the platform you own it on, and it shows up here.
backlog.noMatchHint: Try loosening the filters: ticks within the same criterion add up, so two tags together mean the games that have both.

filters.noStores: No store: games added by hand don't have one.
filters.durationHint: Games with no known length, and games with no ending, stay out: their hours aren't a length.
filters.ratingHint: Games you haven't rated stay out.

addGame.description: Type the title. If you want, search IGDB to link it to the metadata.
addGame.noLinkHint: Without a link the game stays unresolved: no metadata.
addGame.noResults: No results for “{query}”. You can still add it by hand.
addGame.ownershipHint: On PC the same game can live on Steam and GOG: that's two rows.
addGame.duplicate: This game is already in your backlog

game.notFoundHint: This game doesn't exist, or it was removed from the catalogue.
game.notLinked: Game not linked to IGDB: no metadata to fetch.
game.notEnriched: Metadata not fetched yet. Coming shortly.
game.notInBacklogHint: This game isn't in your backlog. You can add it from the backlog page.

hltb.title: How long it takes
hltb.noEnding: This game has no ending: these are hours played, not a length.
hltb.noTimes: HowLongToBeat has no times for this game.
hltb.notFetched: Times not fetched yet. Coming shortly.
